description: SAN-1357 Step 8 · Every CopilotKit consumer in MDE, classified before the v2 migration so 'verify-only' is falsifiable instead of assumed. Vocabulary — migrate: must change in a named step; keep: already on the supported v2 surface, no change expected; test-only: a test, fixture or gate that intentionally names v1 or v2 symbols; compatibility-required: must retain a legacy boundary for a documented reason; remove: dead, delete it. Enforced by scripts/__tests__/copilotkit-consumer-inventory.test.mjs in both directions: every detected consumer must be listed, every listed entry must still be a detected consumer unless it declares `implicitContract: true` with a reason, no listed file may vanish, and no compatibility <CopilotKit> boundary may remain (SAN-1378 Stage D migrated the last four).

consumers.note: Not a @copilotkit importer — it declares the shared props shape locally. SAN-1378 Stage D removed the v1 `agent` carrier and the unreachable `publicApiKey` variant once the last compatibility boundary was gone; `agentId` is the only identity.
Asserts the shared props shape, including `showDevConsole: false` and the absence of the v1 `agent` carrier. Must fail if a legacy prop reappears.

Step 11 combined contract for Steps 9 and 10: asserts the route uses @copilotkit/runtime/v2 with an explicit basePath and mode, that the client and server transport halves agree, that the security gates stay ordered before the handler, and that the v1 agent carrier is present while a compatibility boundary still consumes it. Names the v2 specifier in import-statement assertions rather than in regexes, so comment prose can neither satisfy nor defeat them. Assembles the v1 provider tag from parts so this file is not itself detected as a compatibility boundary.

Step 11 STOP-4: proves the stop request body survives the MDE route intact and reaches the runtime as exactly { runId }, with a built-in negative control showing a non-cloning reader destroys the run scope. Mocks @copilotkit/runtime/v2, so no real runtime is constructed.

Step 10 authenticated single-route /info: drives the real route, real v2 handler and real Mastra agent graph with only the Supabase session and rate limiter faked. Asserts 200, the pinned runtime version and the four canonical agents for a signed-in user, and 401 with no agent list without a session. Flipping the handler mode makes it fail with the production symptom, a 404.
